cases.mechanism_detail: A predicted 918-bp 5'-truncated, reverse-oriented L1 (L1 bases 5141-6059 plus poly(A)) with an 8-bp TSD inserted in LDLR exon 7; homozygous in a severely affected proband and heterozygous in mildly affected parents; expected to disrupt the coding sequence but not validated at RNA or protein level.
cases.quote: Although it could not be validated at the transcript or protein level, this insertion is expected to disrupt the function of the gene (Hancks & Kazazian, 2012) which is consistent with the known disease mechanism.
